title.rendered: Jessica Todd Promoted to Senior Vice President, Director of Finance and Accounting at Averon Trust Bank

content.rendered:
Jessica Todd was recently promoted to Senior Vice President, Director of Finance and Accounting at Averon Trust Bank. She is responsible for all aspects of the Bank’s finance function including staff, systems, and financial reporting, and now also has additional senior management responsibilities.

Jess joined the Bank’s Accounting team in 2004, and has held roles of increasing responsibility throughout her Averon Trust career, most recently as First Vice President, Director of Finance.

“Jess has proven herself as a knowledgeable and important part of the Averon Trust family and we are thrilled to have her join the Senior Management team and take on the day-to-day leadership role within the Finance and Accounting department,” shared Michael Rauh, President and CEO of Averon Trust Bank.

Jess earned a bachelor of science in Business Administration and a master’s degree in Accounting, both from Bryant College in Smithfield, RI. She also has a CPA license, was named a CBA New Leader in Banking in 2012, and completed the ABA Stonier Graduate School of Banking in 2014.

Jess is Secretary of the East Lyme Public Trust Foundation and serves as Treasurer for the East Lyme Middle School PTA. She and her family live in Niantic, CT.
